fact: The Gabon Digital programme plans to interconnect the biometric persons register, the digital ID system and the national civil registry centre through a common biometric referential, per the ANINF and Interior Ministry officials.
The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) provides for a fully digitalised civil registry system that is interoperable with, and distinct from, the RBPP ID system.
system: Civil Registry system and RBPP System
